description: This PHP source file handles AJAX requests for adding a device to a blocked list, either as a managed device or a Wi-Fi MAC filter. It processes POST data, performs validation, updates device lists, and configures MAC filtering on Wi-Fi access points.

methods.name: ajaxSet_addDevice_blockedList.php
methods.description: Main script handling the addition of a blocked device, validating input, updating device management tables, and configuring Wi-Fi MAC filters based on request data.
